description: Monitoring data sets of alpine photovoltaic power-plants is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. On this repository you can find the monitoring data of the 3 PV power-plants analysed in the article "Confirmation of the power gain for solar photovoltaic systems in alpine areas" (doi: 10.3389/fenrg.2024.1372680). Each folder contains the following two elements: 1. README.txt: describes the content of the folder. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by-sa. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
